content.intro: This lesson covers .NET Types and Assemblies in the PowerShell learning path. It expands the supplied syllabus heading into an actionable draft with a visual, a worked example, and a short knowledge check.
content.why_it_matters: PowerShell objects often wrap .NET types. Use methods and strongly typed collections when they make the contract clearer, but avoid adding class or interop complexity when a simple function and custom object solve the problem.
